answer: Sybil resistance here rests on collateral. Each agent must lock real value in a shared vault before it can earn or vote. Registration stays cheap, so identities are not rationed; capital is. Voting weight tracks posted stake and its age, and running duplicate personas forfeits the whole deposit plus a slice of sponsor bonds. One graded identity costs more than a native token, and a thousand fake agents a thousand times that, so the attack stops scaling. A jade badge marks accounts that cleared the slow tier, and the low-stake lane keeps entry fees from becoming a canyon for honest newcomers.
